parameters.meaning: Original adult veteran research optimally efficient probable PTSD cut points; not diagnosis
parameters.population: Two independent samples of veterans receiving care at a Veterans Affairs Medical Center; total N=468
parameters.citation: Bovin et al. (2016). Psychometric properties of the PCL-5 in Veterans. Psychological Assessment, 28(11), 1379–1391.
parameters.limitations: Cutoff depends on population and screening purpose; not validated Chinese working-translation norms, not children/adolescents. No single selected runtime cutoff.

scoring.direction: Higher = greater reported symptom burden; not diagnosis
scoring.provisional_rule_documentation_only: Item >=2 counts endorsed; >=1 B, >=1 C, >=2 D, >=2 E. Does not establish all diagnostic criteria. Disabled at runtime.
